name: Good Morning, Gogy
source:
Good morning! Welcome to the Dream SMP. 

Your name is GeorgeNotFound. You and your friends Dream and Sapnap haven't been on this server for long, but you're already falling in love with your new home. 

You hope that things will never change. 

It's time to start your day!

[From [url=https://asterhours.itch.io/good-morning-gogy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
早上好！欢迎来到梦想SMP。

你的名字是GeorgeNotFound。你和你的朋友Dream和Sapnap进入这个服务器的时间并不长，但你已经爱上了你的新家。

你希望事情永远不会改变。

是时候开始新的一天了！

[来自[url=https://asterhours.itch.io/good-morning-gogy]Itch.io[/url]]
